title: Striking a Pregnant Woman: Fine for the Lost Pregnancy
kjv_text: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman's husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.
summary: If brawling men injure a pregnant woman and she miscarries but suffers no further harm ('no mischief'), the offender pays a fine set by the husband and ratified by judges.
original_audience: Israelite villages; the woman is legally present as her husband's interest.
immediate_context: Sets up vv.23-25: fine for the pregnancy, talion for 'mischief' to the woman.
historical_context: Directly parallel to Hammurabi 209-214 and Middle Assyrian 21, 50-52: caused miscarriage is compensable property-style loss, graded by the woman's status. The interpretive war: 'her fruit depart' = miscarriage (fine only → fetus not reckoned a person at law) vs. premature live birth (Septuagint and later readings). Entire modern abortion theologies hang on this translation choice — the most consequential ambiguity in the chapter.
penalty: Judicially ratified fine, amount proposed by the husband.
exceptions: 'Mischief' (harm to the woman) escalates to talion (vv.23-25).
cross_references: Numbers 5:11-31 (the ordeal that induces miscarriage as divine verdict)
nt_passages: No direct NT engagement; Luke 1:41 (the babe leaped in her womb) is the proof-text pressed into service by fetal-personhood readings.

internal_contradictions.issue: This verse fines fetal loss like property damage while Numbers 5's jealousy ordeal has a priest ritually induce miscarriage — biblical law both prices and performs the act the regime calls murder.

usofc_implementation: The regime's deepest doctrinal landmine. Official translation ('she deliver prematurely') supports total fetal personhood; the Fetal Life Act criminalizes all abortion as murder. But this verse's fine-not-death schedule remains in the canon the state swears is inerrant, and defense attorneys in abortion prosecutions read the KJV aloud, verse 22 then verse 23, and rest. The CSC's harmonization memo is on its ninth revision.
constitutional_analogue: Post-Dobbs fetal personhood statutes; the verse is the ancient text both sides of the American abortion war actually cite.
scene_ideas: An abortion-murder trial turning entirely on the Hebrew of 'her fruit depart' — the state's own expert witness visibly losing his faith in inerrancy on the stand.
The CSC translator who rendered the official version, keeping the older lexicon locked in a drawer.
A Numbers 5 ordeal administered in an FPA clinic while protesters outside carry signs quoting the same Bible.
satirical_uses: The state's inerrant Bible contains the sliding fee schedule its own abortion law says cannot exist.
bureaucratic_uses: The ninth harmonization memo, classified Covenant-Eyes-Only
